overallNotes: Two connector-only slots ('or') that carried no independent operative content were treated as glue and yielded no items: operative:6.01(b)(14)(c)(ii)(ii)#3 and operative:6.01(b)(17)(i)#2.

Cross-references to Section 2.18, Section 6.01(b)(1) (and its sub-parts (X)/(Y)), Section 6.08(a)(3)(b), Section 6.08(b) and Section 6.08(b)(4) listed as unresolved in the batch header did not appear within the text of the 52 slots actually provided in this batch, so no items were created for them here; they should be tracked against the regions where that operative text actually resides.

Clause (22) is cut off mid-sentence at the end of this batch (ends at 'directors,'); its remaining content (e.g., additional categories of persons, any dollar cap, and conditions) is not inventoried here because it was not part of the provided slots.

The $1.00 minimum-incurrence alternative test appears three times (Total Leverage Ratio, First Lien Leverage Ratio, Senior Secured Leverage Ratio pathways) and each occurrence was inventoried separately since they are independent alternative branches under clause 6.01(b)(14)(b)/(c).

The $720.0 million / 100% (or 100.0%) of Consolidated EBITDA 'greater of' basket cap recurs three times (clause (14)(e), clause (18)(i), and clause (19)) and each was inventoried as an independent formula/alternative structure since they are distinct baskets, though they share the same numeric values.

Shared aggregate cap relationships were identified linking Section 6.01(b)(18) with Section 6.01(b)(13), and Section 6.01(b)(19) with both Section 6.01(b)(13) and itself; these are recorded as SHARED_CAP items.
